model: NOVOS 3 / NOVOS 5 RS485 BACnet room operating units
applies_to: Thermokon NOVOS 3 and NOVOS 5 (LCD) wall units with RS485 BACnet MS/TP, in temperature, CO2, humidity and VOC sensor variants.
summary: NOVOS 3 and NOVOS 5 are wall-mounted room sensors and operating units with a BACnet MS/TP interface. They measure temperature and, depending on the variant, humidity, CO2 and VOC, and offer occupancy, setpoint and fan-stage inputs for the room controller in the BMS. Only the main operating values are BACnet objects; the rest is set through a configuration file written with Thermokon's uConfig tool.
notes: Object list from the 'Description of RS485 BACnet Interface NOVOS 3 / NOVOS 5' manual, rev D, pages 4-9. Object names are printed in square brackets in the manual; the brackets are dropped here.
Which AI objects are present depends on the sensor variant (Temp, CO2 Temp, CO2 Temp_rH, CO2+VOC Temp, CO2+VOC Temp_rH).
The icon objects (BV 16-27) apply to the NOVOS 5 LCD; the LED objects (MV 426-427) to units with an LED button.
Temperatures switch to °F when the unit system is set to imperial in uConfig.
The manual has no access column; R/W here is inferred from the descriptions.

integration.summary: Set the MAC address and baud rate with the DIP switches, and the Device Offset ID if needed. Read the sensor AIs and the occupancy, setpoint and fan-stage objects and feed them to the room controller in the BMS; write the LED and icon objects to show states back to the user.

setup: MAC address 1-127 and baud rate (9600-115200) are set on DIP switches; 8N1.
Device instance = Device Offset ID (AV 4180) + MAC address.
Most settings (setpoint range, fan options, offsets, LCD behaviour) are written as a config file with uConfig via BACnet file transfer (FILE 0).
gotchas: LED objects are not stored; write them again after the device restarts.
Changing the unit system to imperial does not rescale the measured-value limits; adjust them by hand.
